scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
Welcome to Luoyang,
a city with a long
and colorful history.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
Recently we've developed
an ocean lane to accomodate
positive exchange with
foreign nations.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: Luoyang is well-known for various specialties in addition to its rich history. Here you can find many things unique to our land.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
Please take your time
and we invite you to enjoy
your trip here in Luoyang.
Ask Building Locations.
Remove all marks from mini-map.
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: Where would you like to go?
Dragon Castle
Doctor's Office
City Hall
Weapon Shop
Tool Shop
Tavern
Cancel

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: The Dragon Castle is located at ^FF3355+^000000. It is where all the nobles reside, including our lord.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: Since you're an outsider, I guess it would be appropriate for you to visit our lord first.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
We have a very skillful doctor.
You can find her office at ^CE6300+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
It is said that there
is no disease she cannot cure. Well, I can't guarantee if that's true or not.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
We have a City Hall where the federal government operates.
It is located at ^A5BAAD+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
If you have any problems,
you should talk with the
employees in City Hall.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: The Weapon Shop is located at ^55FF33+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
You will see
marvelous weapons forged
by the well-experienced
blacksmiths of Luoyang.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: The Tool Shop is located at ^3355FF+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
Knowing your enemy
is half the battle!
It's also safer to prepare yourself than to be sorry later. Why don't you go check their supplies?

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: When you get tired during your trip, I suggest that you visit the Tavern. It's located at ^00FF00+^000000.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
The Tavern is a good place
to meet other tourists, as well as to hear of any news that may be helpful to know.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
If you wish to remove all marks
on your mini-map, please choose 'Remove all marks from mini-map.' from the menu.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text: There, I've erased all the marks on your mini-map. Feel free to ask me about building locations whenever you need to.

scripts.speaker: Soldier
scripts.text:
I guess it's fun
sometimes to go exploring
on your own. Take care.
